name: Hermes Agent
description: Hermes Agent 0.21.3 is a self-hosted AI agent with a gateway API and an authenticated web dashboard.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  hermes:
    image: nousresearch/hermes-agent:v2026.9.24@sha256:fca358f12efd65bfaaca05884166f15c0e2788375ca30d77061ac1ebc96452b7
    container_name: hermes
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - gateway
      - run
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:9119"
      - "8642:8642"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/:/opt/data
    environment:
      HERMES_DASHBOARD: "1"
      HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME: zimaos
      HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD: ""
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
